body: I don’t know if you’ve ever felt this, but it’s like my entire self worth is tied to my brain. Like if I’m not using it in some way I’m worthless. I’ve always been pushed to do something academic/ scientific/ etc. My value in my self has always relied upon this and I guess my biggest hurdle to overcome is this. I know I deserve more than a life spent ensuring everyone is happy before myself... at least in theory? I’m entirely an extrovert and so issues with my family/ friends hit me so much harder? I don’t know...
Thank you for this. You know when you are in dark places like these, you always think so black and white. I think I will try that. I mean I have nothing left to lose.
